name: IC Memory — SPI, 3.6V — Winbond
description: Surface-mount memory IC cluster featuring 3.6V SPI parts in a Winbond USON-8-1EP footprint.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a 3.6V memory IC with an SPI interface.
Choose for surface-mount designs utilizing the USON-8-1EP footprint.
Select when requiring Tier A components such as APS1604M-3SQRx-ZR or APS6404L-3SQRx-ZR.
avoid_when: Avoid when operating voltages other than 3.6V or non-SPI interfaces are required.
Do not use if the PCB layout requires a footprint other than USON-8-1EP.
Do not use if through-hole mounting is required instead of SMD.
